s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Referred to a neurologist
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Dysarthria and slurred speech developed over 3 months
Gait instability developed over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter
No contrast enhancement on T1-weighted FLAIR MRI with contrast
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid presence of lymphoma cells
Bone marrow negative for lymphoma cells

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Extensive nonenhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial presentation with episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
Underwent carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Referred to a neurologist
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Dysarthria and slurred speech developed over 3 months
Gait instability developed over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities throughout the bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter
No contrast enhancement on T1-weighted FLAIR MRI with contrast
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid presence of lymphoma cells
Bone marrow negative for lymphoma cells

raw.rationale: The patient's progressive neurological decline, including right-sided weakness, dysarthria, slurred speech, and gait instability, along with the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and brain biopsy showing lymphoma markers, suggests a diagnosis of encephalopathy due to central nervous system lymphoma.

rejected.label: multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: The absence of contrast enhancement on MRI and the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid do not support a diagnosis of multiple sclerosis.

rejected.label: multiple system atrophy
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not typically match those of multiple system atrophy, which usually presents with autonomic dysfunction and ataxia.

rejected.label: dystonia
rejected.why: While the patient initially presented with spasms and tremors, the subsequent development of progressive weakness, dysarthria, and gait instability suggests a more widespread neurological disorder than dystonia.

rejected.label: parkinsonism
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms, such as tremors and gait instability, could be seen in parkinsonism, but the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and brain biopsy findings suggest a different underlying diagnosis.
